notablePrerequisites: Spike feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability, removing a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder and gaining 2 life.
Target Spike Feeder with Heliod, Sun-Crown's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat for infinite lifegain.
